name: Circuit Atelier defaults
description: Authoring-only scenery placement presets and text for the code-owned Circuit Atelier guide.
placement_help: Choose a preset, then click the canvas to place it. Return to Select / move to select and drag existing objects; Point exposes rotation, size and position.

guide.title: Select, then shape
guide.body: Click road points to expose their handles. Shift-click extends a selection; drag empty space for a marquee. A drag is one undo step; Escape cancels it.

guide.title: Arrange scenery together
guide.body: Select scenery with S. Shift-click adds objects. Group, duplicate, rotate, scale, align and distribute from the contextual selection controls. Locks protect content.

guide.title: Trace without overwriting
guide.body: Draw connected freehand strokes or use Pen. Close the loop, preview the generated road, then explicitly Replace. The existing circuit stays untouched before confirmation.

guide.title: Review before driving
guide.body: Checks points out crossings and pit/timing issues. Click a finding to focus that location. Decorative bridges are not a guarantee of geometric clearance.

guide.title: One circuit, two workspaces
guide.body: Save to the shared library or use Test weekend. The live race receives an independent circuit snapshot. Unapplied trace drafts must be applied or cleared before testing.
